stories.title: Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
stories.summary: Details have emerged about a new zero-day vulnerability in Cacti, an open-source network monitoring tool, that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution. The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, which has yet to be assigned a CVE identifier, has been tracked as 4HTTP2SHELL and 4HTTP2ROOT. stories.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
stories.summary: Popular password management software 1Password on Wednesday disclosed a security incident involving its backend systems that led to the unauthorized access of some customer information, but emphasized that customer password vaults and other secrets were not accessed. stories.title: 100,000 Potentially Impacted by Colorado Data Breach
stories.summary: Hackers breached the digital identification and document storage application myColorado and accessed user-uploaded data.

stories.title: Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach
stories.summary: A vulnerability in hex.pm allowed hackers to run commands on web servers. No evidence of data modification was found, but database reads are not logged.

stories.title: In Other News: Tanker Cyberattacks, EU Quantum Act, New VirusTotal Capabilities
stories.summary: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: RansomwareHelp accused of profiting from ransom payments, USDA payment systems breach, cybersecurity firm Radware hacked.

stories.title: US Air Force cloud platform reportedly hacked in latest federal breach
stories.summary: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, adding to a recent wave of cyberattacks affecting US government agencies, including the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department.

stories.title: Drupal warns of new site takeover flaw exploited in attacks
stories.summary: The Drupal security team says attackers are exploiting a second critical vulnerability that lets them breach and hijack unpatched websites.

stories.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
stories.summary: Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday. cves.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.22, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.22, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.13.
cves.name: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
